CivilDate.description: Valid Gregorian civil date from 1900-01-01 through 2200-12-31; no time zone conversion.

CurrencyCode.description: Supported ISO 4217 code from the bundled currency metadata.

DecimalRate.description: Exact positive decimal text with at most 18 significant digits, 18 fractional digits and 12 whole digits. Zero, exponent notation and binary floating-point conversion are forbidden; precision is checked at runtime.

allOf.description: Shared by both halves of a return ticket, one on the outbound leg and one on the return leg, so they edit and delete together. Optional and never null; an upsert that omits it unlinks that half, and a half without its partner is a plain expense.

rates.description: Exact decimal rate from the base to each supported currency, including the base itself.

MinorUnits.description: Exact nonnegative integer minor-unit string, at most 999999999999. Never a JSON number.

status.description: `notJoined` when the traveller has no TripSplit account on this trip, so nobody can be buzzed. It is not recorded.

NullableCivilDate.description: Valid Gregorian civil date from 1900-01-01 through 2200-12-31; no time zone conversion.

PositiveMinorUnits.description: Exact positive integer minor-unit string, from 1 through 999999999999. Zero is only allowed for budgets and converted totals.

TripOrigin.description: Where the trip sets off from and returns to. Optional and never null; a settings update that omits it keeps the saved origin.

TripReschedule.description: New dates for a trip: its first day, the nights at each of its stops in order, and the days and legs that follow from them. Legs keep their IDs and only change date and day. Every day that leaves the trip names a kept day in `moves`, which its expenses move to, including ones added elsewhere since.

bearerAuth.description: TripSplit access token in the Authorization header, including WebSocket upgrades. Never put credentials in URLs.

info.description: Generated v1 JSON transport contract. Money and rates are exact decimal strings. Runtime refinements, authorization, transactional sync rules and WebSocket semantics are specified in api/docs/protocol.md. Public HTML invitation and Apple association documents are outside this JSON API description.
